facts.fact: La Nation reports that Djibouti Telecom, Ethio telecom and Sudatel signed a tripartite agreement in Djibouti on 4 February 2026 for the construction and maintenance of the Horizon cross-border terrestrial fibre link joining Djibouti, Ethiopia and Sudan.

On Monday 7 September 2026 the three operators presented Horizon in Addis Ababa to hyperscalers, carriers and vendors in a pre-commercialisation phase, seeking partner interest and feedback before deployment and commercial launch; the document describes the infrastructure as future.

facts.fact: Tech Africa News reports that Ethio telecom has moved from planning into active deployment of the Horizon Fiber corridor linking Djibouti, Ethiopia, Sudan and Jeddah, with end-to-end architecture finalised and site-material procurement and delivery complete so physical deployment can proceed.
The document states a memorandum of understanding for Horizon Fiber was signed in Addis Ababa on 3 December 2024 and a binding agreement followed on 4 February 2026.
